title: Google Cloud revenue doubles to $30.7bn, beating forecasts
content:
Google Cloud more than doubled its revenue in the third quarter, beating analysts’ forecasts, Alphabet said on Wednesday. Weaker growth in search advertising, however, meant the group as a whole fell short of expectations.
Cloud revenue rose 103% from a year earlier to $30.7bn, according to Alphabet’s quarterly results. Analysts had expected $29.57bn, Reuters reported, citing LSEG data. The unit’s operating profit climbed to $11.1bn, from $3.6bn a year earlier.
Google Cloud is the world’s third-largest cloud provider, behind Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure. Use of its AI models is also growing.
Pichai said Google’s systems now process nearly 32 billion tokens a minute, more than four times the level a year ago. The Gemini app has about 1 billion users, he added.
Cloud customers have also signed up for much more work ahead. The unit’s backlog of contracted revenue reached $561bn, and Alphabet expects to recognise more than 55% of it within two years, according to Reuters.
“We had a strong quarter and are now on a half-trillion dollar revenue run rate,” said Sundar Pichai, Alphabet’s chief executive.
Alphabet’s total revenue grew 25% to $127.6bn, slightly below the $128.2bn analysts had forecast. Advertising brought in $82bn against expectations of $83.4bn, as more people used Google’s AI Mode in search, Reuters reported.
Spending on AI infrastructure also kept rising. Alphabet spent a record $51.4bn on property and equipment in the quarter, more than double a year earlier. As a result, its free cash flow was negative $9.1bn for a second straight quarter.
The company kept its forecast for this year’s capital spending at $195bn to $205bn, the range it set in July. Its finance chief said spending would rise significantly again in 2027 but gave no figure.
Net income fell 25% to $26.2bn, mainly because of an $8.7bn loss on equity investments. Alphabet shares dropped about 10% in after-hours trading.
Demand for Google’s own AI chips is also part of the cloud story. Earlier this week, The Information reported that OpenAI plans to buy Google’s TPUs.

report.summary: 谷歌云营收翻倍至307亿美元，超市场预期
report.background: 谷歌云长期位居全球第三大云厂商，排在AWS与微软Azure之后，多年来一直被视为Alphabet的"烧钱部门"。随着大模型训练与推理需求爆发，云厂商的收入结构正在从卖存储、卖虚拟机转向卖AI算力与模型服务。本季度Alphabet整体营收增长25%，但搜索广告因AI Mode改版而略低于预期，同时资本开支创下新高，市场对"AI投入何时回本"的疑虑集中爆发，导致财报后股价盘后下跌约10%。
key_points: 谷歌云季度收入307亿美元、同比翻倍，营业利润从36亿增至111亿美元，首次证明AI云业务可以规模化盈利。
Pichai披露系统每分钟处理近320亿token，是一年前的4倍多；Gemini应用用户约10亿，模型调用量成为新的增长引擎。
已签约但未确认的合同收入（backlog）高达5610亿美元，其中超55%预计两年内兑现，为未来收入提供了罕见的可见度。
本季资本开支创纪录达514亿美元、同比翻倍多，自由现金流连续两季为负91亿美元，全年指引维持在1950-2050亿美元。
云业务高歌猛进，但广告收入820亿美元不及预期、净利下滑25%，叠加OpenAI拟采购谷歌TPU的消息，算力外销成为新变量。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，云收入翻倍印证了推理需求正在真实变现，token消耗量取代GPU出货量成为更有效的景气指标，算力军备竞赛仍将继续。对开发者，谷歌云盈利改善意味着TPU与Gemini生态会获得更持续的投入，多一个可与英伟达、Azure抗衡的选择；但云价格上涨压力仍在。对普通用户，搜索被AI Mode重构带来的广告变现阵痛，最终可能转化为更强的订阅制与AI功能捆绑。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注 Vertex AI（模型托管与推理平台）、Gemini API 与 Gemini CLI、Google Cloud TPU（算力租赁与JAX生态）、BigQuery（数据与向量检索）、以及 Agent Development Kit（ADK）用于构建智能体应用。
